calibration_rulings.title: "North of Al-Ahsa" («شمال الأحساء») on the two lake pages: a part of Al-Ahsa, or a direction from it?
calibration_rulings.binds: hubail-lake: summary, body, area, faq[1].a; delfoon-lake: body, area, faq[1].a — unchanged from stage 4.
calibration_rulings.ruling: THE WORDING, ruled for the text until the owner answers: B, «الاحساء کے شمال میں», in the seven leaves. Of the three candidates it asserts least: it is the line's approved build for a direction named after Al-Ahsa («الاحساء کے مشرق میں») and, like the Arabic, is also said of a place in a region's north; A states that the lakes are a part of Al-Ahsa and C that they are outside it, and neither source establishes either. Ruling N74 is not reopened: its ground was thulaim's own text. THE FACT is the OWNER'S DECISION and is not settled here: do Al-Hubail Lake and Delfoon lie inside Al-Ahsa (then «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» in all seven leaves, one replacement, and the English may say "in the north of Al-Ahsa"), or north of it? With it goes the wider defect: the site uses "Al-Ahsa" for the oasis, the city area and the governorate from page to page. ROUND 2: unchanged; the seven leaves carry one wording and the fact is still the owner's. ROUND 3: unchanged; the fact is still the owner's. RECORDED HERE, in the ruling itself (proof pass on round 2, finding 15): the same Arabic words, «شمال الأحساء», are «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» on the applied thulaim, where ruling N74 read them by that page's own text, and «الاحساء کے شمال میں» on the two lake pages; the owner's answer evens the two out. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-13) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN. The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 5): N88: do the two lakes lie inside Al-Ahsa? ‖ AMENDED IN b16 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; OWNER DECIDED 2026-10-15 (DECISIONS «Owner's answers on 2026-10-15»: Al-Uqair (port, castle, mosque, beach), Hubail and Delfoon lakes and al-Qarah village are all INSIDE Al-Ahsa), carried into the source by #175; item N241 A): THE FACT: the two lakes lie inside Al-Ahsa. THE WORDING: «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» in the seven leaves (b16), the form this ruling named for that answer; the interim B («الاحساء کے شمال میں») is withdrawn and stands nowhere. The split recorded above is evened out: one wording for «شمال الأحساء» on thulaim and the two lake pages. The guard 'none says "part"' is withdrawn with B.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader and the stage checker: «الاحساء کے شمال میں» does not occur; the seven leaves carry «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں».

calibration_rulings.title: "Bodies of water" in the owner's guarded claim on asfar (build check C31: «من أكبر التجمعات المائية»), and "a body of water" of hubail-lake («مسطح مائي»).
calibration_rulings.binds: asfar::summary (change 0 of round 1); hubail-lake::body (change 19 of round 1). The Urdu pattern of build check C31, which the coordinator derives from asfar's summary as it stands after the last round.
calibration_rulings.ruling: B for the claim, E for the lake. Both stand in round 2, each contested by one reader, and this is why. (1) asfar's summary: «خلیجی خطے کے سب سے بڑے آبی اجسام میں سے ایک». The three points build check C31 holds every language to are kept and are what the Urdu pattern is to be derived from: AMONG the largest («میں سے ایک»), BODIES OF WATER («آبی اجسام» — not «جھیل», not «قدرتی»), of the REGION («خلیجی خطے», the Gulf bare: ruling P5). THE TWO READERS SIDE BY SIDE: the first read the earlier wording and pictured a man-made tank behind a dam — a wrong picture of the place, on the owner's guarded claim; the second read «آبی اجسام», understood it as water bodies, and found it a word-for-word, textbook phrase. One wording misleads and the other stumbles; on a guarded claim the one that does not mislead stays. The second reader's own wording, «خلیجی خطے میں پانی کے سب سے بڑے ذخیروں میں سے ایک», is candidate C, the noun that misled the first reader, and is not taken. No third wording is coined: none was found that keeps the three points. ON RECORD FOR THE OWNER, one line each: candidate C as the second reader words it; and 'lakes', the first reader's remedy, which the owner's own guard forbids. (2) hubail-lake's body follows the Arabic's other noun: «پانی کا ایک پھیلاؤ», the phrase asfar's body has for the same Arabic word. The second reader finds that the sentence defines a lake as water and sounds translated, and would drop the predicate; both sources open with it ('Al-Hubail Lake is a body of water …'), and a predicate of the field's source is not dropped for register (ruling P24): his sentence is on record for the owner, «جھیل الحبیل الاحساء کے شمال میں ہے۔». The singular «آبی جسم» is attested and is not taken there. (3) The earlier noun and its plural are withdrawn for a natural or drainage-fed lake: the word is a store of water and is read as a dam's reservoir. For a reservoir it is the right word. HOW THIS AND THE GUARD AGREE (proof pass on round 1, finding 20): the guard forbids the two forms wherever this entry is in force (the attraction batches of the line's round 3), and no page of this batch speaks of a reservoir; the page that does raises the word as its own item, and its judge lifts the ban in his own file — this entry carried there with its guard reworded, and the key back in his `termbase_final` — until then the form is not written. COST, stated: «آبی اجسام» is schoolbook Urdu and cost the second reader a stumble on the first line of the page; charged under nativeness and fit on asfar. ROUND 3: BOTH STAND, each now contested by the two readers who have read it, neither misread. (1) The claim: two readers independently wrote the same sentence with «پانی کے … ذخیروں». Its noun, in the build of stages 1 to 5, gave the first reader a dam's tank; their own build has been read by nobody; the claim is the owner's guarded one. The last round changes a wording only to cure a misreading and only for a wording a reader has passed: neither holds. THE OWNER'S DECISION, no longer a mere option: «آبی اجسام», which is understood and sounds like a textbook, or the two readers' sentence. (2) The opening of hubail-lake: two readers wrote the same sentence without the predicate. It is the source's predicate and ruling P24 keeps it; THE OWNER'S DECISION likewise. ‖ ENTERED ON APPLY (2026-10-13) AS AN OWNER DECISION, OPEN (the judge file gives this entry the status "ruled"; by the proof pass on round 3, finding 1, accepted in the judge's addendum, it is entered with its open question stated, as N88 and N100 state theirs). The wording ruled above is what the text carries until the owner answers; no leaf waits on the answer. THE QUESTION, as the list for the owner in the judge file words it (its note FOR THE OWNER, decision 3): N93: (a) asfar's guarded claim — «آبی اجسام» (understood; textbook to two) or the sentence two readers wrote, «خلیجی خطے میں پانی کے سب سے بڑے ذخیروں میں سے ایک»; (b) hubail-lake's opening without 'a body of water', «جھیل الحبیل الاحساء کے شمال میں ہے۔», which two readers wrote. ‖ AMENDED IN b16 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; items N241, N251): hubail-lake's body now says «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» (owner, inside). Question (b), should the owner take it, reads «جھیل الحبیل الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں ہے۔»; the on-05 reader of b16 wrote that sentence with the withdrawn noun of (3) added after the position (item 28, ruled open_item; not a third candidate). The ruling, the guard and the open question are otherwise unchanged.

calibration_rulings.title: The order of an area line whose source names no larger place as a bare name ('Al-Battaliyah village — northeast of Hofuf', 'Al-Koot district — central Hofuf').
calibration_rulings.binds: jalaniyah::area, unchanged. BINDS b4: hubaish «محلہ جنوبی الرفعہ، ہفوف کے وسط میں», umzurainiq «محلہ العویمریہ، ہفوف کے وسط میں» and uqair-mosque's area line keep the source's order as they stand. Round 1's six lines (al-uqair, jawatha-mosque, ameeriah, khuzam, baiah, uqair-castle) stand unchanged. Every later area line of the pattern. ROUND 2: unchanged for both batches.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. Where the source's area line names no larger place as a bare name — it gives a village, a quarter or a port and then where that lies by a direction or a part of the town — the Urdu keeps the source's order: the place with its generic, then «،», then the position, which ends in a postposition: «البطالیہ گاؤں، ہفوف کے شمال مشرق میں», «محلہ الکوت، ہفوف کے وسط میں». Ruling P20 is untouched and holds wherever the source names a larger place as a bare name: that place leads («ہفوف، محلہ الکوت»; «الاحساء، مشرقی دیہات میں التہیمیہ گاؤں»). The two orders are therefore two cases of one rule — what the source gives as a bare larger name leads, and what it gives as a position follows — and no line of round 1 moves. Cost, stated: the same quarter can still stand quarter-first on one page and town-first on another where its sources word the line differently; that is logged with the sources' defects and is the owner's to even out in the source. On record for him, one line: B for every such line («ہفوف کے شمال مشرق میں، البطالیہ گاؤں»), which would move ten lines on applied pages. ‖ b4, ROUND 1: adopted as b3's judge ruled it; nothing moves. hubaish::area and umzurainiq::area keep the source's order and end in a postposition; uqair-mosque::area is the approved line of uqair-castle from the translation memory, which also ends in one; tahimiyah-e and abubakr-mosque lead with the larger bare place (ruling P20). b4's first reader read the five rows and remarked, as a minor item, that the row is built four different ways and that he had to re-orient each time (observation 7): the two cases of this rule over four wordings of the sources, logged with the sources' defects as this entry says. The checker's three notes of ruling P20 on b4 are these three lines and are expected. b4, ROUND 2: unchanged. The second reader of b4 (his item 47, minor) notes that abubakr-mosque's row puts the town first where hubaish and umzurainiq put the quarter first: the two cases of this rule over the sources' wordings, logged as before. The checker's three notes of ruling P20 are still these three lines. ‖ b5, ROUND 1: adopted and applied on four lines. The sources of shaban, kanzan, arbaa and thulaim give two positions and name no larger place as a bare name, so each line keeps the source's order and ends in a postposition: «التویثیر کے قریب، ہفوف کے مشرق میں», «ہفوف کے شمال مشرق میں، الشعبہ اور الکلابیہ گاؤں کے قریب», «ہفوف کے جنوب مشرق میں، الطرف نامی قصبے کے قریب», «العیون شہر کے مغرب میں، الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں». tuwaither's source names the larger place bare and its line leads with it (ruling P20): «الاحساء، مشرقی دیہات میں التویثیر گاؤں», the approved build of both tahimiyah lines. The stage checker's four notes of ruling P20 on b5 are these four lines and are expected. In round 1 arbaa's line changed only in the place of the town's generic (item N73-generic-for-a-town); what thulaim's second position says is item N74-area-line-north-of-al-ahsa. The first reader (his item 42, moderate) notes that tuwaither's row is built differently from the other four: the two cases of this rule over the sources' wordings, logged as before. ROUND 2: arbaa's line changed again by one word, «نامی», between the town's name and its generic (item N73-generic-for-a-town as amended; round 2's change 6); it keeps the source's order and ends in a postposition. The other four lines are round 1's. The second reader, too, notes that tuwaither's row is built differently from the other four (his item 38): the two cases of this rule over the sources' wordings. ‖ AMENDED IN b16 (judge round 1, 2026-10-15; items N241, N242, N245, N247): the lines of al-uqair, uqair-castle, uqair-mosque, uqair-beach, najim-museum and delfoon-lake keep the source's order and end in a postposition, with the position now «الاحساء کے مشرقی حصے میں» / «الاحساء کے شمالی حصے میں» (owner, inside; #175); the two port cells stay one string. The checker's six NOTE P20 on b16 are these lines and are expected.
